prediction.ECE: sum over bins of absolute hierarchical observed mass minus hierarchical predicted mass; compute after aggregation
prediction.multiclass_brier: sum of five squared probability-minus-onehot errors, then hierarchical mean
prediction.contacts: known WT reference CA distance <8 angstrom and sequence separation>=3
prediction.noncontact_relationships: known WT reference CA distance >=8 and <15 angstrom and sequence separation>=3
prediction.missing_stratum: retain every candidate and WT; if any candidate has zero known stratum pairs, mark aggregate stratum undefined with explicit roster/counts
prediction.unknown_labels: exclude from probability correctness metrics, record all unknown coverage explicitly; preserve outcome bounds in decision diagnostics

common_retained.intersection: all candidate retained reference relationships, including unknown-coordinate relationships
common_retained.primary_choices: read existing frozen primary choices; never reselect using diagnostic scores
common_retained.empty_intersection: explicit undefined full-roster comparison, no complete-case bootstrap

historical_static_matching.scope: descriptive feasibility only; report zero support without relaxing rules

statistics.unit: WT means within homology component, then equal component means

information_boundary.interpretation: historical development diagnostics, not independent confirmation, no scientific pass threshold

timing_note: exploratory diagnostic definitions frozen after inspecting first-seed development CE/choices, before this per-pair audit; no confirmation labels used
